scientific_integrity: The coefficient data for Phi_35, known maximum-gap theorem, and existing binary and ternary families are acknowledged; no independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The affine frequency law is proved by block-period insertion; the 24 residue-case arithmetic is reproducibly exhausted by integer code. Only Phi_{35p} for prime p>35 is covered. Novelty checks cannot guarantee absolute historical priority. No independent review performed.
title: Affine gap-spectrum law and second-largest gap for \(\Phi_{35p}\)
